column2: Select 4-8 shirt colors that work with design (Gildan 64000)
Set retail pricing (2.5-3x markup, aim for $10-15 profit)
Publish to Shopify and verify it appears
Use bulk editor to clean up and organize
Create or generate homepage hero banner
Add trust badges (Free Shipping, Guaranteed, Secure, Fast)
Set up navigation menu (Home, Shop, About, Contact)
Customize colors and fonts to match brand
Set up shipping profile and rates ($4.99 standard, free over $75)
Create policy pages (refund, shipping, privacy, terms)
